body:
To sump up here, I think this is a good discussion starter. Today the drawbacks of our widget's states + search parameters state are:

1. syncing two widgets is not working
2. creating your own widget is hard
3. code complexity introduced by multiple stores

Possible answers:

1. I am sure we can work around this
2. This is an issue, but if we provide all the needed connectors there should be almost no cases where you need to actually create a completely new widget, only connect
3. This is an issue clearly.

I am all in if anyone have clear ideas on how to solve this, even if it requires rewriting/deleting some good code. Today the state is that we are multiple people concerned by this issue, but we will only fix it once we know what to do about it and open a PR.
